text:
Connor O'Brien: Heads up: starting GA release train coordination for Hosted canary rollout workflow. Need to align on (a) flag flip plan, (b) staged rollout by region, (c) required signoffs, (d) rollback criteria. I’ll paste a strawman below—please poke holes.

Connor O'Brien: Strawman plan (prod):
1) Mon 10:00 PT: enable control-plane read-path compat (rollout_policy_v2 reader) everywhere (no UI exposure)
2) Mon 13:00 PT: enable data-plane weighted routing for Hosted behind flag `hosted_rollouts_weighted_variants`
3) Tue 09:00 PT: enable Console wizard + create/update endpoints behind `console_hosted_rollouts_ga`
4) Tue 11:00 PT: lift entitlement gate for GA plans (Enterprise + Dedicated Hosted add-on) + allowlist 5 pilot accounts
5) Wed: expand allowlist to 20 accounts + turn on EU region
6) Thu: remove allowlist (GA)

Connor O'Brien: Staged regions proposal:
- Stage 1: us-east-1
- Stage 2: us-west-2
- Stage 3: eu-west-1
- Stage 4: ap-southeast-1
(keeping ap-southeast last b/c lower oncall coverage)

Talia Benson: +1 to having us-east-1 first. Also want to ensure we have explicit go/no-go checkpoints between stages. Can we do “1 region per business day” instead of same-day expansions?

Marissa Cole: Agree w/ 1/day. Also: GA comms are queued for Thu AM. If we slip “remove allowlist” to Fri we need to update messaging.

Dylan Brooks: Console-side: wizard is solid but we still have one bug in preview effective routing when route has region override + account policy. Fix is in review. I’m okay gating UI enable until that lands.

Chloe Martin: Backend endpoints are ready behind the flag. One note: create/update is idempotent but clients MUST send `if_match` version on update or they’ll get 409. UI handles it; API users might need docs callout.

Ethan Park: Control-plane: rollout_policy_v2 migration is safe to read; write path is still behind `rollout_policy_v2_writes`. We should *not* enable writes globally until after SRE confirms staleness SLO dashboards are green in the first region.

Sean Gallagher: SRE POV: we can support staged by region, but we need crisp rollback triggers. Suggested criteria for auto-stop/rollback:
- rollout-policy eval error rate > 0.1% for 10m in region
- propagation staleness p95 > 60s for 15m after change events
- Hosted route 5xx delta candidate-baseline > +0.5% for 5m (for any enabled canary route)
- streaming mismatch incidents (cross-variant mixing) = immediate rollback

Allison Grant: +1. Also add latency guardrail for control-plane and data-plane:
- control-plane eval latency p95 < 25ms (SLO)
- data-plane routing overhead p95 < 2ms (measured via router span)
If we see router overhead jump, we roll back the data-plane flag but can keep the control-plane readers.

Logan Wright: Telemetry is ready. Reminder: variant label cardinality controls are in place but if customers use very long route names we’ll get truncation in dashboards. Not a blocker but support should know. Also: per-variant cost metrics roll up every 1m; early in canaries the graphs look noisy.

Dev Patel: Support asks: what’s the customer-visible “GA date” we should quote this week? We’ve been saying “late next week” to a couple of accounts.

Marissa Cole: If staged goes smoothly: Thu is still the goal for “GA available” (no allowlist). We can soft-launch earlier to allowlisted accounts Tue/Wed.

Marcus Lin: Security signoff conditions:
1) audit events emitted for create/update/pause/rollback (with actor, route, before/after)
2) confirm no prompt/content logged in audit payloads
3) ensure RBAC permissions enforced (no “editor can rollback” surprises)
If we can get evidence (screenshots / sample events) from staging + one prod region, I can sign.

Kevin Osei: +1, and please ensure audit events are in the export pipeline (SIEM) with the final event names. We had a previous situation where staging used `rollout.change` and prod used `rollout.policy.change`. Need consistency.

Paula Mendes: For entitlements: we’re gating by plan + permission `rollouts:manage`. Default roles mapping updated in rbac bundle. Connor, please coordinate w/ Kaitlyn if we need a temporary exception role for the pilot customers.

Connor O'Brien: Got it. Updated plan proposal (based on feedback):
- Day 0 (Mon): enable control-plane *read* compat globally (no customer impact)
- Day 1 (Tue): enable data-plane weighted routing in us-east-1 only
- Day 2 (Wed): enable Console wizard + endpoints in us-east-1 + allowlist 5 accounts
- Day 3 (Thu): expand to us-west-2 + allowlist 20 accounts
- Day 4 (Fri): expand to eu-west-1 + remove allowlist (GA)
- Following Mon: ap-southeast-1

Connor O'Brien: That moves GA to Fri. Marissa—ok to move comms?

Marissa Cole: Fri GA is acceptable, but we should notify marketing today. Soojin will update the announcement copy and schedule.

Wei Chen: Docs can meet Fri GA. One request: please freeze API surface by Wed EOD so we can finalize screenshots and the “update semantics” section (409s / if_match) + guardrail guidance.

Dylan Brooks: For UI freeze: ok. Pending PR for preview endpoint layering fix should land today. If it slips, we keep UI disabled and only enable backend + allowlist for API users.

Sean Gallagher: One more thing: we need a pre-launch “kill switch” checklist:
- confirm `hosted_rollouts_weighted_variants` can be disabled per-region quickly
- confirm rollback semantics for streaming: variant pinned at request start; retries reuse selection
- confirm oncall runbook link in dashboards

Allison Grant: I’ll verify SLO dashboards and alerts in us-east-1 before we proceed to Day 2. Also want the alert routing configured to page only when allowlist > 0 (otherwise too noisy during internal enable).

Logan Wright: For that: we can add alert condition “rollout_change_events > 0” in last 15m AND “variant_dimension_present = true”. That keeps it quiet when no one is using it.

DeployBot: deploy status: rollout-control-plane@v2.18.4 scheduled for us-east-1 2024-10-01 18:30 UTC (includes monotonic version checks + propagation retries)

Connor O'Brien: Nice—this includes the propagation race fix, right?

Ethan Park: Yes, v2.18.4 includes monotonic version enforcement in the policy cache and backoff retries on regional write propagation.

Marcus Lin: Re audit: can someone drop a sample event payload from staging (redacted) and confirm the field list? I want to verify we don’t include request headers / session IDs.

Chloe Martin: I can paste a staging sample. It includes `actor_id`, `actor_email`, `route_id`, `account_id`, `action`, `before`, `after`, `reason` (optional), and `request_id`. No prompt or completion. Session IDs are not included.

Kevin Osei: `request_id` is fine. Just ensure it’s internal UUID, not customer-provided. Also confirm retention = standard 365d and export is enabled for enterprise.

Paula Mendes: Retention is standard audit retention; export enabled for enterprise via existing pipeline. Event names are finalized as:
- `rollouts.policy.created`
- `rollouts.policy.updated`
- `rollouts.policy.paused`
- `rollouts.policy.rolled_back`

Connor O'Brien: Great. Signoffs needed before each stage (please confirm owners):
- SRE: Sean / Allison (dashboards + alerts green, rollback ready)
- Security: Marcus / Kevin (audit event correctness + export)
- Product: Marissa / Paula (entitlements + comms)
- Console Eng: Dylan / Chloe (UI + API ready)
- Platform: Ethan (policy engine + propagation)

Talia Benson: Add explicit “Go/No-Go” for Day 2 (Console enable + allowlist). I’ll schedule 15m check-in Wed 09:00 PT.

Dev Patel: Support readiness: we’ll prep macros for “how to pause/rollback” and “how to interpret baseline vs candidate graphs”. Please make sure the runbook is final by Thu morning.

Sean Gallagher: Runbook is basically done; needs final screenshots from the dashboards. Rafael’s updating it.

Wei Chen: Docs PR will include a troubleshooting section that links to the runbook + common guardrail defaults. If there are recommended defaults (latency/error thresholds), send them by Wed.

Allison Grant: Recommended defaults (for docs):
- error rate guardrail: +0.2% absolute over baseline (5m window)
- latency guardrail: +50ms p95 over baseline (5m window)
- cost guardrail: +10% tokens/$ over baseline (15m window)
Make it clear these are starting points.

Marissa Cole: Works. Also we should enforce “can’t set 100% candidate” without explicit confirmation + at least one guardrail enabled unless admin override.

Chloe Martin: Validation currently requires at least one guardrail when candidate weight > 0, unless caller has permission `rollouts:override_guardrails`. UI doesn’t expose override.

Connor O'Brien: Perfect. Final rollback criteria (release train):
- Any region-level regression in routing overhead > 2ms p95 sustained 10m => disable `hosted_rollouts_weighted_variants` in that region
- Any propagation staleness p95 > 60s sustained 15m after rollout changes => stop expansion; if customer-impacting, disable writes and revert to baseline-only policies
- Any customer report of cross-variant mixing in streaming => immediate region rollback + incident
- Any audit export failures for rollout events in enabled region => pause expansion until fixed

Connor O'Brien: If no objections, I’ll update the release checklist and start Day 0 Monday.

Sean Gallagher: No objections. Please tag me when you flip Stage 1 in us-east-1 so we can watch dashboards live.

Marcus Lin: Same—tag me when audit events are flowing in prod so I can sign off.

Marissa Cole: :thumbsup: Proceed.

Talia Benson: :white_check_mark: I’ll send calendar for Wed check-in + Fri GA checkpoint.

Connor O'Brien: Thanks all. I’ll post the updated checklist link in #eng-releases once it’s edited.
